_comment: Cases that are known to differ from mongod 7.0.45 and why. A case listed here is reported as K (known), not F; the report lists them. Nothing here is hidden: each entry names the cause.
g07.locale.en_US_POSIX: ICU 57 tailors en_US_POSIX to ASCII code-point order; the ICU4X collation data has no such tailoring (root order is used)
g07.locale.lv: ICU 57's Latvian tailoring (y sorting with i) is not in the newer CLDR data of ICU4X, which orders lv like root
g07.locale.se: Northern Sami tailoring (a-ring, a-umlaut, o-umlaut after z) is missing from the ICU4X data used by this build
g07.locale.smn: Inari Sami tailoring is missing from the ICU4X data used by this build
g07.locale.kl: Kalaallisut tailoring is missing from the ICU4X data used by this build
g07.locale.haw: Hawaiian tailoring is missing from the ICU4X data used by this build
g07.locale.cs@collation=search: the 'search' collation type of cs differs between CLDR 29 (ICU 57) and the CLDR of ICU4X
g07.locale.de@collation=search: the 'search' collation type of de differs between CLDR 29 (ICU 57) and the CLDR of ICU4X
g07.locale.sk@collation=search: the 'search' collation type of sk differs between CLDR 29 (ICU 57) and the CLDR of ICU4X
g05.sum_avg.double_accumulation: mongod's double summation ($sum/$avg of doubles of mixed magnitude) differs from the engine's compensated (Kahan) sum in the last bit for some data; the exact algorithm of mongod was not recovered (see results-gaps.md)
